messages:
Raj Patel: Hey infra — last-minute ask. We need 2x A100s in asia-southeast1 for an inference smoke test this Sunday night (22:00-04:00 UTC). Can someone confirm availability or a quick swap from demo pool?
Ivy Chen: Which project / cost center? any PR to reference for the reservation?
Raj Patel: Project: feature/inference-scaling (cost center: infra-rd). PR: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/pull/482 — it's a tiny reservation block. Time window is tight, test is to validate kv-cache perf with live traffic replay.
Sam O'Neill: I can try swapping but need to know if we can degrade to 1x A100 + 1x L40s if A100s are blocked by vendor. Elena, vendor ETA on additional A100 slots?
Elena Gomez: Vendor update: their APAC pool shows 0 spare A100s until monday morning. They can offer 1x A100 immediate if we accept short-term billing bump. Otherwise fallback to L40 is possible. Pinged account rep for a 2hr hold — waiting reply.
Raj Patel: OK noted. If only 1x A100 available, fallback plan: 1x A100 + 1x L40 and run a reduced throughput smoke. Can QA still run coverage?
Nora Ops: QA ok with reduced throughput, but test harness needs a tiny config change — see snippet below. I'll apply if infra confirms reservation.
Nora Ops: ```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_reservation" "smoke_test" {
  region = "asia-southeast1"
  sku    = "a100"
  count  = 2
  window = "2026-03-21T22:00:00Z/2026-03-22T04:00:00Z"
  tags   = ["smoke","inference-replay"]
}
```
Ivy Chen: Raj — can you link the terraform PR and mark the resource name so I can review? Also add fallback flags for L40.
Raj Patel: PR https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/pull/482 updated with fallback block and comments. cc @Ivy Chen.
Sam O'Neill: Quick heads-up — if we do demo-pool swap we need approval from billing for short-term bump. I'll DM finance.
Elena Gomez: Rep just replied: can hold 2x A100 for 6 hours if we sign off within 30m. Price ~ +18% for the slot.
Raj Patel: Can someone approve the short-term bump? It's within project budget but needs a quick thumbs.
Ivy Chen: +1 from infra side, we need to smoke. Whoever approves, please add note to PR.
Nora Ops: QA: +1. I'll run the reduced harness if only 1x A100.
Sam O'Neill: I approved with finance (sent email). Will update PR comment now.
deploy-bot: reservation: created redwood_gpu_reservation.smoke_test (id: res-20260321-617890) — status: pending-provisioning
Raj Patel: Awesome — thanks everyone. If provisioning fails, fallback plan: run on EU-west1 L40 pool and run extended run next Tuesday.
Ivy Chen: Noted. I'll merge PR once the deploy-bot goes green. :thumbsup:
Elena Gomez: Vendor confirmed provisioning start in ~12m.
Raj Patel: Quiet ask — if anyone oncall sees provisioning flake overnight, please ping me directly. Thanks all.
